That sibling task's own summary (specs/304_out_of_repo_pathspec_aborts_whole_commit/summaries/01_out-of-repo-pathspec-containment-summary.md) names this explicitly as 'an unconnected partial_blockers_detail jq enhancement' from the declared overlap set 184/263/273/279/284/285. This saved the implementation phase from needing to re-derive and land the core jq fix from scratch; remaining work is narrower: add the missing verbatim_goal field to the render, remove the now-defensive-only 2>/dev/null, extend test fixture 830 to assert on issues.jsonl content, and settle the class/severity/volume classification questions.
